static_traits.name: Chen Yili
static_traits.family_status: Grew up with parents by the sea,without siblings
static_traits.social_status: Has several good friends, but does not easily open up about Self-doubt; due to self-blame and not accepting praise, Interpersonal relationships are somewhat strained
static_traits.medical_history: deny prior psychotherapy history;deny prior similar problem history;without obvious physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to reflect on own experiences; slightly tense but highly cooperative; tends to use self-Demands and self-blaming expressions, difficulty accepting others' praise

basic_info.main_problem: I tend to downplay the positive aspects of myself in hobbies and interests, leading to self-criticism and Self-doubt. These feelings began a year ago after blaming myself for a failed cake-baking.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize Self-doubt and self-criticism have affected my ability to enjoy hobbies and damaged my self-esteem, so I hope to get help through counseling.
growth_experiences: Family-of-origin and background: grew up with parents by the sea,without siblings. Has several close friends to confide in, but finds it hard to express Self-doubt.

Key turning event (a year ago): Cake burning while baking, attributing the failure to one's own insufficient ability, after which self-criticism and Self-doubt began appearing frequently in hobbies and interests, worsening especially after small mistakes in cooking, baking, DIY and other activities.

core_beliefs: My value depends on whether I achieve perfection in every aspect

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not get it right the first time, it means I am not suited to keep doing this
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constraining oneself through self-criticism, and reducing or avoiding baking to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should not like baking that much; I am not really good at this

special_situations.event: Tried a new recipe a few days ago but with poor results
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot master the new recipe right away, it means I will never learn it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Setting harsher standards for oneself, pursuing perfection, repeatedly reflecting on mistakes and self-blaming
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough; I will never do well at cooking

special_situations.event: Friends praising his works or performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others praise, it is mostly just politeness or comfort and cannot be taken seriously
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Denying or downplaying positive feedback, reducing in-depth communication with friends to avoid embarrassment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just saying nice things; I actually have not done well

special_situations.event: Encounters tasks at work that require creativity or relate to personal interests
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the work is not good enough, I will be negated by others, proving I am not up to it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinates or avoids high-exposure creative tasks, or is excessively self-critical after completing them
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I make a mistake, everyone will think I am not professional; I will fail

core_conflict.wish: To be accepted and recognized, to freely enjoy hobbies even when imperfect
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated, humiliated, or losing value for not being good enough
defense_goal: Avoiding external negation through perfectionism and self-criticism
Keeping some distance from others to reduce the risk of exposing imperfection

object_relations.object_representation: A picky or insincere other (praising on the surface, judging inside)

object_relations.self_representation: An individual needing to prove worth through performance
object_relations.object_representation: An authority/audience controlling evaluation and recognition
object_relations.linking_affect: Tension, stress, fear of being negated

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others give positive feedback, praise, or normalize mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The other person is just comforting me or being perfunctory; I actually did not do well (transference: projecting past experiences of being judged onto the present)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying compliments, using vague words (like 'not bad'), quickly shifting to flaws or mistakes.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to talk in depth about the emotional feelings of Self-doubt and failure experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If exposing vulnerability will lead to being judged or looked down on (transference: treating others as picky judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Replacing emotional expression with objective narration, calm tone, using analytical language to avoid emotional words.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about recent failures or small mistakes (such as a failed recipe)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The fault is mine; only by harshly pointing at myself can worse outcomes be prevented (transference: internalized critic)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Self-blaming statements increase, wording is harsh; if gently confronted, may respond with even stronger self-criticism.

manifestations: Introjecting the rule 'must perform perfectly in everything', feeling bound by shoulds and musts
Contracts choices and attempts in creative and hobby activities out of fear of failure
outcomes: Self-limitation and avoidance, experiencing restricted Freedom
Persistent anxiety and self-criticism, lowering Self-efficacy

manifestations: Not easily opening up to friends about Self-doubt, fearing judgment
Suspicious of others' praise, believing it is just politeness, reducing genuine connection
outcomes: Increased sense of Strained and distant interpersonal relationships
Positive support hard to internalize, Reinforcing negative self-schema

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Self-Demands with 'must/should' (like thinking 'should not enjoy baking that much')
Treating perfection as the only standard of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Slightly nervous and cautious in counseling, worried about exposing shortcomings and being judged

positive_force: Having some Reflection and Learning motivation, willing to try problem-solving and cognitive restructuring
Has several friends who can support (potential support resources)
Stays passionate about interest activities; willing to keep practicing and improving
Able to identify the problem's impact on self-esteem and life, already tried mindfulness and self-compassion
negative_force: Perfectionism and the mindset of equating mistakes with failure
Tends to devalue positive feedback and results; hard to internalize affirmation
Mind reading and predicting failure, magnifying the likelihood of others' negating evaluations
Frequent self-blame and self-criticism, relying on external approval to evaluate self-worth
Avoidance and Withdrawal after setbacks, leading to a negative cycle of interests and relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Strong self-criticism and negating positive feedback after mistakes in hobbies and Work tasks
antecedent: Baking or cooking failures occur (such as a burnt cake, a failed new recipe)
Takes on creative tasks or tasks related to personal interests at work
target_behavior.core_reason: Perfectionist beliefs and the core belief 'I am not good enough', equating one mistake with total failure, and relying on others' judgments to determine self-worth
target_behavior.function: Escapes feelings of failure and shame, trying to gain a sense of control and assurance of improvement through self-blame
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced enjoyment and persistence in hobbies, damaged self-esteem, affected Work performance and Interpersonal relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids socializing or keeping distance from friends after Self-doubt
antecedent: Feeling shame and unease after making mistakes
Receiving praise but doubting its sincerity
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being judged for exposing imperfection, seeing others as potential critics
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the possibility of being negated and the resulting emotional discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension, insufficient use of the support system, sense of Loneliness and Self-doubt worsens
